headline: Khaitan & Co assists RPG Life Sciences on carve-out of its API business
sum: RPG Life Sciences Limited has carved out its active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) business into a wholly-owned subsidiary company, RPG Active Pharma Limited. Khaitan & Co advised RPG Life Sciences on this business carve-out as well as…
detail: RPG Life Sciences Limited has carved out its active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) business into a wholly-owned subsidiary company, RPG Active Pharma Limited. Khaitan & Co advised RPG Life Sciences on this business carve-out as well as on the subsequent investment by PE-investor InvAscent. The transaction team consisted of Haigreve Khaitan (Managing Partner), Shishir Jose Vayttaden (Partner), Aditi Singhvi (Partner) and Bhaskar Vishwajeet (Associate), with assistance from the following: Real estate aspects: Harsh Parikh (Partner), Rahul Sunil Agarwal (Principal Associate) and Raghav Manojkumar Pareek (Associate); Intellectual property aspects: Nirupam Lodha (Partner), Toshani Mukherjee…
